title: Expected comparisons for selection
statement: For every linearly ordered type and every natural number $n$, the supremum of the expected number of comparisons made by the randomized selection procedure, over all ranks and all input lists of length $n$, is at most $10n$.
hypotheses_covered: The elements belong to a linearly ordered type
